location.venue_or_area: Club Byron, 18 to 20 Marvell St (night parties) and Marvell Hall, 37 Marvell St (workshops)

audience.psychographics: Latin social dance community (salsa, bachata, kizomba, zouk, tango) from Byron, the Gold Coast, Brisbane and interstate, plus beginners via a dedicated Beginners Hub; workshops by day, parties with DJs and a live band by night.

add_sources.note: @byronlatinfiesta profile links to byronlatinfiesta.com.au; site carries the 2026 program, tickets and organiser details.
About page: Sky created the Byron Latin Fiesta in 2006; Picante Productions is the producing company; footer names 'Sky Blue - Director'.
2026 venues: Club Byron hosts the Friday to Sunday night parties (bar and bistro, 'Drinks at Club prices'); Marvell Hall hosts two workshop days.
Site lists info@byronlatinfiesta.com.au and 0413 146 889 as the general contact; no dedicated sponsorship page.
'Byron Latin Fiesta 2026, 21st Edition', 29 Oct to 1 Nov 2026, '4 nights and 3 days'. Created 2006 and 2026 is the 21st edition, so 2025 was the 20th (held annually per NSW events listing).
'Australia's longest-running Latin dance festival, held annually in the heart of Byron Bay' (Google snippet).

Home page: Beginners Hub and pass, DJs across 4 party nights (salsa, bachata, reggaeton, kizomba, zouk, tango), live Latin band. IG collaborators are dance schools from Byron, the Gold Coast and Sydney.
About page 'Supporters' logo strip: Accommodation Byron Bay, North Coast Events, Latin Spirits, Aula, Dance Fever, ByronBay.com. Latin Spirits, Aula and Dance Fever logos were uploaded Oct 2025.
Group post: 'Thank you Byron Bank, our presenting sponsor' for the Byron Latin Fiesta; edition year not visible (Google snippet).
Venue partner Club Byron runs the bar and bistro for the party nights.
